sweep.protocol: STR pairs: clean row + corrupted row (other prompt of the pair) per directed case; spawns parent = corrupted, clean = clean
sweep.command: python scripts/ext7_wino_sweep.py --model qwen3 --pairs data/dial/pairs_acon_a2e_qwen3.parquet --case-sets data/dial/case_sets_acon_a2e_qwen3.json --out p6_acon_a2e_qwen3 --agent p6-data --max-rows 60000

joint.command: python scripts/ext7_wino_joint.py --model qwen3 --pairs data/dial/pairs_acon_a2e_qwen3.parquet --case-sets data/dial/case_sets_acon_a2e_qwen3.json --out p6_acon_a2e_qwen3 --agent p6-data --families main --max-rows 30000

dla.command: python scripts/ext7_wino_dla.py --model qwen3 --pairs data/dial/pairs_acon_a2e_qwen3.parquet --case-sets data/dial/case_sets_acon_a2e_qwen3.json --out p6_acon_a2e_qwen3 --agent p6-data --families main --chunk 512

direct_split.command: python -m moetrace.ext7_controls direct --model qwen3 --pairs data/dial/pairs_acon_a2e_qwen3.parquet --case-sets data/dial/case_sets_acon_a2e_qwen3.json --out p6_acon_a2e_qwen3 --splits discovery,validation
